# CLI and Script Execution

Covers dimension 4 (CLI/Script execution). All citations reference entries in
[citations.md](../citations.md).

---

## Execution Methods

Tines offers three distinct code execution paths, each with different
capabilities and constraints.

### 1. Run Script Action (Cloud)

| Attribute | Value | Source |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| Language | Python 3.13 only | [10] |
| Runtime | AWS Lambda (same region as tenant) | [10] |
| Input payload limit | 6 MB | [10] |
| Output payload limit | 6 MB | [10] |
| Package size limit | 250 MB unzipped | [10] |
| Ephemeral storage | 756 MB | [10] |
| Default timeout | 10 seconds | [10] |
| Max timeout | 110 seconds | [10] |
| Dependencies | requirements.txt format, built as Lambda layers | [10] |
| Function signature | `def main(input):` returning JSON | [10] |
| Security | Isolated Lambda; restricted IAM role; tenant-exclusive | [10] |

**Key constraint:** Python only. Cannot execute arbitrary shell commands,
`gh`, `gws`, or other CLI tools. First execution incurs Lambda cold start
delay [10].

### 2. Command-over-HTTP (Cloud + Self-Hosted)

| Attribute | Value | Source |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| Supported executors | python3, bash, powershell | [11] |
| Request format | JSON: `{"executor": "bash", "script": "..."}` | [11] |
| Target URL | `https://command-over-http/run` | [11] |
| Cloud availability | Tunnel add-on required (contact support) | [11] |
| Self-hosted availability | Included | [11] |
| Docker image | `tines/command-over-http:latest` | [11] |
| Access | Via HTTP Request action with tunnel enabled | [11] |

**This is the path for arbitrary CLI execution.** The bash executor can run
any command available in the container environment. For self-hosted
deployments, the command-over-http container runs on the local network and
can be customized with additional tools installed.

However, for cloud deployments, this requires the tunnel add-on (additional
cost, contact support) [11].

### 3. Self-Hosted Command Runner

| Attribute | Value | Source |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| Container | tines-command-runner | [42] |
| Port | 4400 | [42] |
| Default timeout | 60 seconds | [42] |
| Max timeout | Configurable via RUN_SCRIPT_MAX_TIMEOUT | [42] |
| Isolation | Unique Linux user per team | [42] |
| CA certificates | Configurable via UV_NATIVE_TLS env var | [42] |

This is the self-hosted equivalent of Run Script, handling Python execution
locally rather than via AWS Lambda.

## Stdout/Stderr Capture

For **Run Script**: The return value of `main(input)` becomes the emitted
event. stdout/stderr are not explicitly documented as separate streams [10].

For **Command-over-HTTP**: Output is captured in the HTTP response body [11].
The documentation does not specify whether stdout and stderr are separated or
merged.

## Can It Run Arbitrary CLI Tools?

| Requirement | Run Script | Command-over-HTTP | Self-Hosted Runner |
|-------------|-----------|-------------------|-------------------|
| `gws gmail +triage` | No (Python only) | Yes (bash) | No (Python only) |
| `gh pr list` | No | Yes (bash) | No |
| Custom Python scripts | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Pass output to next step | Yes (JSON return) | Yes (HTTP response) | Yes (JSON return) |
| Available on free tier | Cloud only | No (tunnel add-on) | No (self-host req.) |

**Critical finding:** The #1 requirement (arbitrary CLI execution) is only
achievable via Command-over-HTTP with the bash executor. This requires either:
- Self-hosted deployment (Business/Enterprise tier), or
- Cloud deployment with tunnel add-on (additional cost)

Neither option is available on the Community Edition.

For self-hosted deployments, custom CLI tools like `gws` and `gh` would need
to be installed in the command-over-http container or accessible from it.

---

## Gaps and Limitations

- **No native shell execution action** — must use Command-over-HTTP
  workaround [10][11]
- **Python-only on cloud Run Script** — no bash, no arbitrary CLIs [10]
- **Command-over-HTTP requires tunnel add-on for cloud** — not included in
  base pricing [11]
- **Stdout/stderr separation undocumented** — unclear if streams are merged
  or separate [10][11]
- **Custom tool installation** — documentation does not cover installing
  additional binaries in the command-over-http container
- **110-second max timeout on cloud** — may be insufficient for long-running
  CLI operations [10]
